SMTO-CFG-0079 — SMTO's automatic Skill picker gave an unusable answer

GUID: afbf4776-62f7-5bda-bb59-979335c7c3fa
Slug: capability-selection-output-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: capability_selection

What happened

  • The model that picks Skills for each request suggested one outside the allowed list. SMTO ignored it, and the request continues with only the Skills it was already allowed to use.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let the task continue and check its result as usual. The task still runs with the Skills it is allowed to use; only the bad suggestion was dropped.
  2. If this message appears often, open Settings › Setup › Model routing and find the Automatic capability selection row. That row shows which model, Helper or Main, picks Skills for each request.
  3. In that row's Destination, choose Main, or ask the person who manages SMTO to set up a stronger Helper model. A model that follows instructions well suggests only Skills from the allowed list, and Main is usually the stronger model.

What success looks like

  • New requests show Capabilities selected in the task activity without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details in this panel and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't turn on extra Skills to work around it; the picker can only choose from Skills you already allow.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The capability selector's hint was invalid (schema_version not 1, or selected_skill_ids outside the candidate catalog); initial selection degrades to the accepted ceiling, while dynamic activation fails closed.

What this means

  • A selection hint has an invalid version or names Skills outside the accepted candidate set; initial selection may use its existing permitted-ceiling fallback. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • A selection hint has an invalid version or names Skills outside the accepted candidate set; initial selection may use its existing permitted-ceiling fallback.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the safe selection reason and whether this is initial selection or dynamic activation; dynamic activation does not get a full-ceiling fallback.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the rejected selector output and the run's candidate catalog and ceiling (degraded_reason_code output_invalid). If it recurs, route Automatic capability selection to a model that follows strict tool schemas in Model routing; the fallback grants no capability beyond the accepted ceiling.
  • Inspect the rejected selection and current permitted set; preserve the runtime's accepted fallback or report repeated invalid selector output.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The accepted selection contains only allowed candidates or the runtime's existing recorded fallback.

What not to do

  • Do not overwrite the original state with an incompatible version; use the supported upgrade path.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
